title: Expose the project room in the snapshot; implement the input floor with S1-04
why: issueRoomToken requires a roomId and transferInputFloor an expectedRoomRevision, but no operation returned either: sophia.room_state (0001) existed without a way for a client to read it.

S1-04's acceptance requires two participants to pass the input role, so transferInputFloor ships with S1-04 instead of S1-05. Its response stays ExchangeReceipt; until S1-05 opens exchanges, exchangeId identifies the floor change itself.
